description: Fidelity eval cases. Each asks a question whose answer netdistill preserves (anomalies, inventory, presence/absence). Graders are deterministic: all must_contain substrings present AND no must_not_contain substrings present, case-insensitive.

cases.question: Which BGP neighbors are NOT in the Established state? List their neighbor IP addresses.
How many BGP neighbors are configured in total? Answer with just the number.
Which OSPF neighbor is stuck in the EXSTART state? Give its neighbor ID.
Which device is connected to local interface Gi0/0?
Which interface is showing a high number of CRC / input errors? Give the interface name.
Which interface is DOWN but NOT administratively shut down? Give its name.
Which routing table / VRF has NO default route (no gateway of last resort)?
List the BGP neighbor IP addresses configured on this device.
What is the hostname of this device?
